An '''embassy''' existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] prior to [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]] and was owned by the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]]. It was [[Massacre at the Gran Protectorate Embassy|destroyed]] by fire in 52 BBY according to police forces and investigators from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]
